name: Sampler-level step skips (AdaptiveDiff, SADA, ZEUS, sampler EasyCache)
plain: AccelDiff also replaces k-diffusion sampler loops with versions that skip model calls based on the output's trend. These live in the sampler rather than a model patch, so they can skip every cond at once. AdaptiveDiff checks second-difference smoothness, SADA uses a momentum sign and Lagrange interpolation, and ZEUS uses a fixed modular skip pattern.
math:
AdaptiveDiff: skip if |(d_t+d_t−2)/2 − d_t−1| ≤ d_t−1·threshold and not in the last max_skip_steps run of skips.
SADA: _sada_criterion; skip if momentum_mean ≤ 0 in acc window, up to max_interval; Lagrange interpolation on x0 in lagrange mode.
ZEUS: skip when i%denominator ∈ modular in acc window; PSI interpolation of d, odd skips reuse.
Sampler EasyCache: accumulated_error<threshold, first ret_steps and last step forced.

props.hook: Custom SAMPLER (KSAMPLER subclass); not a patcher hook
props.architectures: Sampler level; any model. SADA samplers subset listed in nodes.py.
